titulo: One step to the side of the doorway
caption:
One step to the side of the doorway

He stopped to check his bag right in the doorway, noticed who was waiting, and took one step to the side.

A doorway is a bad place to stop, and one step to the side lets everyone through.

For whoever steps out of the doorway to check their things.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door frame in the middle. A ink-black block figure with white eyes stands in the doorway looking down while a royal blue block figure walks up from the left and waits, trembling with narrowed eyes. The black one's eyes go wide, it steps to the right out of the doorway and the blue one walks into it. Both end with happy eyes. The text changes from: me checking my bag in the doorway, to: stepped aside. they got through.
